sentences.l2: 町に新しい図書館を建設する計画が決まった。
sentences.l1: The plan to build a new library in the town was decided.

sentences.l2: 設計を担当した建築家は、地元の人々の声を取り入れることを大切にした。
sentences.l1: The architect who was in charge of the design valued incorporating the voices of the local people.

sentences.l2: 話を聞くと、静かに本を読める場所だけでなく、家族で気軽に集まれる場所を求める人が多かった。
sentences.l1: When he listened to them, many people wanted not only a place where they could read books quietly, but also a place where their families could gather casually.

sentences.l2: そこで、大きな窓から光が入る開放的な空間を作り、子供が遊べる部屋も設けた。
sentences.l1: So he created an open space where light comes in through large windows, and also provided a room where children can play.

sentences.l2: 完成した図書館は明るい雰囲気で、今では町の新たな憩いの場になっている。
sentences.l1: The completed library has a bright atmosphere, and now it has become a new place of relaxation for the town.
